entries.ui_location: Virtual pump screen > Pump Definition row
entries.description: Footnote appended at the end of the pump definition for pump types whose basal or bolus increments are a list of fixed values rather than a range. Starts with an asterisk; keep it.
Description under the Virtual pump plugin name: used for pumps AAPS cannot control, so the user delivers insulin by hand and the loop runs open (suggestions only).
Row label on the virtual pump screen; the value is a multi-line list of the imitated pump's capabilities (bolus step, extended bolus, basal and temporary basal limits).

entries.ui_location: Virtual pump screen > Pump Definition row
entries.description: Multi-line value of the 'Pump Definition' row; keep the \n line breaks and placeholder order. %1$s bolus step (U); %2$s extended bolus step, %3$s its duration step in minutes, %4$s its maximum duration in hours; %5$s basal rate step or range; %6$s temporary basal (TBR) min-max, %7$s TBR step, %8$s TBR duration step in minutes, %9$s max TBR duration in hours; %10$s an optional footnote. Step means the smallest increment the pump accepts.
Row label on the virtual pump screen; the value is the name of the real pump model the virtual pump imitates (chosen in its settings).
Title of the virtual pump's settings screen (choice of imitated pump type, status upload).
